name: cumulus-sync
description: Two-way sync of your Obsidian vault with pCloud, desktop and mobile.

scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack --log-level warn build crates/wasm --target web --release --out-dir pkg && node scripts/wasm-hash.mjs write
scripts.spike: npm run build:wasm && node esbuild.config.mjs spike && node scripts/.out/spike.mjs
scripts.version: node scripts/version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
